item.title: Google Extends Pixel Updates to Seven Years for Users
item.description: Google guarantees seven years of OS upgrades and security patches for Pixel 8 and newer, surpassing competitors and redefining Android device longevity.

item.title: Google Moves Pixel Production to Vietnam, India by 2027
item.description: Google will cease all Pixel manufacturing in China, relocating phones, watches and earbuds to Vietnam and India, with full transition slated for 2027.
